result.requirement: The system shall generate high-risk transaction alerts and perform refund/chargeback impact analysis to prevent financial loss before settlement.
result.business_need: The business needs to proactively identify fraudulent patterns and quantify potential financial exposure to stop unauthorized chargebacks before funds are settled.
functional_behaviour: The system shall analyze transaction indicators such as unusual order patterns, high-risk addresses, and payment anomalies to calculate fraud likelihood.
The system shall project the financial impact of potential refunds and chargebacks on net settlement amounts for the involved parties.
The system shall flag transactions exceeding the calculated risk threshold for immediate review by the Payment Provider.
The system shall update the Financial Transaction Record with the risk assessment status and projected liability.
The system shall notify the Payment Provider and Store Partner of the flagged transaction and the estimated financial impact.
related_information_requirements: Indicators and historical data used to assess the likelihood of fraudulent transactions
The complete record of monetary exchange detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, and net settlement amounts
Verifiable evidence that the physical goods have reached the customer
Verified details about the ordering individual including unique identifiers and delivery addresses
business_rules: A transaction must be flagged if the calculated fraud likelihood score exceeds the configured risk threshold.
The projected financial impact must include the sum of item costs, delivery fees, taxes, and platform commissions.
A transaction must remain flagged until the Payment Provider confirms the outcome or the settlement period expires.
The impact analysis must be recalculated if new delivery proof or customer verification data becomes available.

acceptance_criteria.given: A new Order Request contains indicators of unusual order patterns and a high-risk address
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the transaction for settlement
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall generate a high-risk alert and update the Financial Transaction Record with the projected chargeback liability

acceptance_criteria.given: A transaction is flagged as high-risk but lacks sufficient delivery proof
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to finalize the settlement calculation
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall withhold the net settlement amount and notify the Payment Provider of the pending dispute review
